hypotheses.name: a frame lock precedes the runaway
hypotheses.prediction: in >= 80% of diverged coarse champion cells a lock (>= 10 steps) starts at or before onset
hypotheses.statement: divergence begins when the unfolding branch, chosen by the learner's own prediction, locks onto the mirrored frame

hypotheses.name: stable learners do not lock
hypotheses.prediction: no lock in >= 80% of non-diverged coarse champion cells and in >= 80% of coarse lr-0.01 cells
hypotheses.statement: cells that stay stable, and the lr-0.01 learner, never hold the mirrored frame

hypotheses.contradicted_by: either probe diverging in >= 50% as many coarse cells
hypotheses.name: removing the self-reference removes the runaway
hypotheses.prediction: each of probe:gru_no_unfold and probe:gru_unfold_dr diverges in <= 20% as many coarse cells as the champion
hypotheses.statement: training on the folded observation, or unfolding around a prediction-independent reference, prevents M2
